sentence: This project builds a program that helps materials science researchers process and manage the large data volumes that advanced microscopes produce.
This project builds an instrument that uses high frequency and high magnetic fields to study unpaired electrons in chemical compounds.
This project develops a way to reuse battery electrodes without breaking them down into raw materials.
This project helps teachers show how machine learning algorithms learn from data to make predictions.
This project builds solar powered sensors that track the behavior and health of cattle on farms and keep the network safe from cyberattacks.
This project tries to find the small molecules that fungi make and tests how they affect plants.
This project builds a program that teaches instructors about Industry 4.0 technologies used in advanced manufacturing.
This project builds a software platform that uses artificial intelligence to find weak points in how organizations use cryptography.
This project builds a quantum compiler that turns programs into more reliable and efficient instructions for real machines.
This project builds a simulator that creates realistic virtual scenarios for testing and training robots.
This project makes and studies Josephson junctions built from spin-triplet superconductors to detect quantum states that could form quantum bits.
This project builds a framework that makes artificial intelligence models easier to explain for science and engineering.
This project builds a computer model that answers questions about an image and explains its reasoning in natural language.
This project sets up a shared high-performance computing cluster to support artificial intelligence research in areas such as cybersecurity and smart transportation.
This project develops lessons on Monte-Carlo simulators that use random number sampling to make predictions in particle and nuclear physics.
This project studies how legumes sense small signaling peptides during root nodule symbiosis using gene editing.
This project uses a robot and computer simulations to test how foot shape changes the force from soft ground such as sand.
